title: Token economics mini-log (personal bench notes)
body:
Quick personal tracker for small experiments around token cost/latency tradeoffs. Not formal; meant to be a compact reference while iterating on batching/quantization heuristics.

-- Table (CSV-style) --
date,exp_id,model,quant,batch,seq_len,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_per_sec,cost_per_1k_tokens,notes
2025-02-18,exp-2401,redwood-7b,8-bit,1,64,42,120,980,0.065,baseline single-request no cache
2025-02-19,exp-2402,redwood-7b,8-bit,4,64,58,180,3600,0.019,batch=4 good throughput, tail latency hit
2025-02-20,exp-2403,redwood-7b,int8,8,128,90,250,7200,0.010,try larger seq -> throughput up but p95 climbs
2025-02-22,exp-2410,redwood-7b,q4_0,16,64,135,420,11500,0.006,very cheap tokens, decode quality seems slightly off for rare tokens
2025-02-25,exp-2422,redwood-13b,8-bit,2,64,85,240,2100,0.12,13b cost doubles but latency also larger; consider dedicated pool
2025-02-27,exp-2430,redwood-7b,int8,4,256,210,620,5400,0.012,longer seq cruel to p95; KV cache test next

-- Quick takeaways --
- Small batches (1-4) keep p50 reasonable for seq<=64; batches >=8 increase p95 rapidly.
- q4_0 gives big cost wins but watch for hallucination/rare-token errors in targeted evals.
- For user-facing low-latency routes, favor batch<=2 + prefix cache; for async background jobs, push larger batches and q4.

-- Mini checklist / TODOs --
- [ ] Run targeted decoding quality eval on q4_0 vs int8 for our prompt set (priority).
- [ ] Try prefix KV cache on exp-2430 scenario and remeasure p95.
- [ ] Add a column for median tokens emitted per request to normalize cost.
- [ ] Hook these runs to the small benchmarking harness and store artifacts in s3 (link in GH PR).

-- Notes to self / context --
- These numbers were run on a dev single GPU (A100-sim), not production Dedicated pool; expect differences.
- Cost estimates are back-of-envelope: "cost_per_1k_tokens" uses instance effective cost from my notes (see linked PR).
- I keep this sheet minimal so I can copy/paste rows into a full spreadsheet when prepping a proper write-up.

-- Quick links / references --
- GH bench harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks
- Slack thread: #infra-bench (see thread ts 2025-02-18 for raw logs)

-- Open questions --
- Is q4_0 acceptable for customer-facing completions when we can apply conservative rerank / critiquing?
- When does dedicated capacity pricing make more sense than hosted per-token (estimate threshold ~X tokens/day)? (need to compute with finance)

-- Scratchpad notes (short-form) --
- If adding prefix cache reduces p95 by >30% for seq=256, then cost win for batch 8 becomes attractive.
- Consider experiment: keep batch=4 but increase CPU-side concurrency to keep latency under SLO (measure tail).
- Remind: log raw samples of generation for q4_0 to audit quality regression later.
